description: Route-specific festival surcharge in its stated week.
Week falls within explicit Feb 24 to Mar 8 flood disruption range.
Festival note belongs to Ahmedabad-Mumbai, not Delhi-Jaipur.
Flood note ended Mar 8; follow-up note is not a positive cost driver.
Stable-demand note is not evidence of a cost-increasing event and is dated after the target week.
Diesel price increase applies to all routes in the dated week.
Toll note explicitly says affected routes are not in this dataset.
Compliance costs were absorbed without a rate change.
